import sys, json, random, subprocess, time, resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tests')
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('public_child_guard', '/workspace/child_guard.py')
guard = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(guard)
from run import req, job
SERVICES=[{'name':c,'label':i+1} for i,c in enumerate('ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP')]
LIMITS=job([])['limits']
rng=random.Random(9)
def words(count, length):
    seen=set(); out=[]
    while len(out)<count:
        w=''.join(rng.choice('ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP') for _ in range(length))
        if w not in seen: seen.add(w); out.append(w)
    return out
pol=' '.join('match(%s) allow;' % ','.join(w) for w in words(4090,16))
drops=' '.join('%s drop;' % a for a in ['contains(A,B)','endswith(C,D)','startswith(E,F)','contains(G,H)'])
events=[{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':pol+' '+drops},{'op':'inspect'}]
data=req([job(events, services=SERVICES, limits=LIMITS)])
env=dict(PATH='/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/workspace', LANG='C', LC_ALL='C',
         TMPDIR='/workspace/tmp', PYTHONHASHSEED='0', PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1', PYTHONUNBUFFERED='1')
t=time.time()
p=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/launch.py','/workspace/project'],
                   stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                   env=env, cwd='/workspace', preexec_fn=guard.restrict)
p.stdin.write(data); p.stdin.close()
out=p.stdout.read(); err=p.stderr.read(); rc=p.wait()
ru=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print('rc=%d time=%.1fs maxrss=%.0f MiB out=%dB' % (rc, time.time()-t, ru.ru_maxrss/1024.0, len(out)))
print(out[:200])
print('err:', err[:200])
EOF
